reasoning: There are no credible statewide general-election polls for the 2026 presidential or U.S. Senate races in Wisconsin within the last 45 days, and the Marquette Law School and Wedgewood polling currently available focuses on the 2026 governor race and hypothetical matchups, not on an actual Senate or presidential contest.[13][16][20] Structurally, Wisconsin’s Cook Partisan Voting Index is EVEN, indicating the state votes in line with national presidential results and remains a pure battleground rather than leaning clearly Democratic or Republican. Given the absence of recent, race-specific statewide polling for Senate or president, the best characterization of the current margin is that both contests are effectively toss-ups (EVEN) rather than measurably D+ or R+ at this time.
